acceptanceCriteria.statement: Section closes when clear: system checklist, then reason required
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
When no blockers exist, the popup opens at **Close Section: Pre-closure Checklist**: 6 system-checked rows (deductible, litigation, subrogation/salvage, reserves, payments, provider), each with a green icon. Nothing is ticked by hand. **Continue** leads to a required **Closure reason** (Section Finalised / Section Not Pursued / Section Rejected), then **Close Section**. The row updates to Closed.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira lists closure reasons only for the claim: "Claim Finalised / Claim Not Pursued / Claim Rejected". The section-level reasons Section Finalised, Section Not Pursued and Section Rejected are made up by the prototype. Not in Jira, pending product sign-off.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Claim is clickable; an open section shows as a blocker in the claim closure popup
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement:
**Close Claim** on Overview is always clickable (it only waits briefly while the check runs). If any section is still Open, the claim closure popup opens on its blocker list with *N open section(s) must be closed before claim closure*. With all sections Closed, that blocker is gone.

**NOTE [accepted-deviation]:** Jira says: "Claim closure initiation available only when all sections are Closed". The screen differs from Jira: Close Claim can always be clicked and the open sections show as a blocker inside the popup. The BMPCC-11360 ticket file describes the same button differently, so the two files disagree until product decides. Pending product sign-off.
